source_datasets.notes: Integer full-count census table; verbatim ten-column frame (Islam, Kristen, Katolik, Hindu, Budha, Khong Hu Chu, Lainnya, Tidak Terjawab, Tidak Ditanyakan, Total). Both margins close exactly: every province row sums over the nine category columns to its printed Total, and every category column sums over the 33 provinces to its printed national control; national Total 237,641,326.

source_datasets.notes: 34 ADM1 provinces, boundaryYearRepresented 2019. Kalimantan Utara (created 2012) is dissolved into Kalimantan Timur to reconstruct the single 2010 province, giving 33 units that join the SP2010 frame one-to-one after a three-name crosswalk (Aceh, DKI Jakarta, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta). The extent spans lon ~95-141E, lat ~6N-11S, far from the antimeridian; no dateline handling needed.

indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: Province all-persons population in the SP2010 religion table.
indicators.method: Printed province Total column, SP2010 'Penduduk Menurut Wilayah dan Agama yang Dianut'.
indicators.quality_notes: All persons of all ages. The Total includes the Tidak Terjawab (not answered) and Tidak Ditanyakan (not asked) residual columns, kept as published.

indicators.label: Islam (reference group) %
indicators.description: Reference-group share: the share of the province Total reporting Islam, the largest published national category, held constant across every province. Declared construct under the minority-share design (project-lead ruling task 6): the value is that group's share of the census frame, never a measure of affiliation versus non-affiliation.
indicators.method: 100 * Islam / Total. The Total includes the two non-response residual columns, which stay in the denominator and in neither slot.
indicators.quality_notes: Minority-share design (BD/PK/LK/NP family; conductor ruling 2026-07-12). The composition signal (Islam-dominant west; Protestant/Catholic Nusa Tenggara Timur, Papua, Papua Barat, Sulawesi Utara, Maluku; Hindu Bali) is what the two slots surface, and the full nine-column composition rides verbatim on each row's quality flag. Percentages use each province's published census Total. The two non-response columns (Tidak Terjawab = not answered; Tidak Ditanyakan = not asked) stay in the denominator and outside both numerators; the two shares therefore need not sum to 100%.

indicators.label: Minority share %
indicators.description: The summed share of the six named non-reference religions (Kristen, Katolik, Hindu, Budha, Khong Hu Chu, Lainnya). Arithmetic on the published categories, never a no-religion measure; the official frame has no no-religion category.
indicators.method: 100 * (Kristen + Katolik + Hindu + Budha + Khong Hu Chu + Lainnya) / Total. The two non-response residuals stay in the denominator and in neither slot; the two shares need not sum to 100.
indicators.quality_notes: The no_religion slot carries the named-minority share under the minority-share design; the field name is the legacy slot key and carries no no-religion semantics.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.description: Indonesia SP2010 census-affiliation share by province.

legend.denominator: province census Total, including a non-response residual

visual_layers.notes: Census affiliation, not practice, attendance, or membership. Single wave (SP2010). The seven-religion composition rides verbatim on each row's quality flag; a dominant-religion / composition view is downstream page design.
